verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a payments platform with a public API, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no official MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint. The llms.txt file, the REST APIs and the single webhook OpenAPI spec are adjacent agent-readiness features, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
